CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "read_at" timestamptz,
  "recipient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "submission_id" uuid,
  "title" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_type_check_c7ac7b0c" CHECK ("type" IN ('SUBMISSION_RECEIVED', 'REVIEW_STARTED', 'REVIEW_COMPLETED', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'SUBMISSION_APPROVED', 'SUBMISSION_REJECTED', 'REVIEW_ASSIGNED', 'SYSTEM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."project_submissions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "live_demo_url" character varying(2048),
  "owner_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "repository_url" character varying(2048) NOT NULL,
  "screenshots" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "submitted_at" timestamptz,
  "summary" character varying(300) NOT NULL,
  "technologies" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "project_submissions_screenshots_elem_not_null_5a300cad" CHECK (array_position("screenshots", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "project_submissions_status_check_6e490a70" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED', 'IN_REVIEW', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'RESUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')),
  CONSTRAINT "project_submissions_technologies_elem_not_null_89b37e18" CHECK (array_position("technologies", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."review_assignments" (
  "assigned_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reviewer_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ASSIGNED' NOT NULL,
  "submission_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "review_assignments_status_check_bfa78172" CHECK ("status" IN ('ASSIGNED', 'ACCEPTED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reviews" (
  "accessibility" int4 NOT NULL,
  "code_quality" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "decision" text NOT NULL,
  "documentation" int4 NOT NULL,
  "feedback" text NOT NULL,
  "functionality" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "overall_score" numeric(3,2) NOT NULL,
  "responsiveness" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reviewer_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "revision_number" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "submission_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ui_ux" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "reviews_decision_check_449fc192" CHECK ("decision" IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."submission_status_history" (
  "changed_by_id" uuid,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "from_status" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "submission_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "to_status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "submission_status_history_from_status_check_3d464584" CHECK ("from_status" IN ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED', 'IN_REVIEW', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'RESUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')),
  CONSTRAINT "submission_status_history_to_status_check_3b6ee6b5" CHECK ("to_status" IN ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED', 'IN_REVIEW', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'RESUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "avatar" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "email_verified_at" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'STUDENT' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_7da8de5a" CHECK ("role" IN ('STUDENT', 'REVIEWER', 'ADMIN')),
  CONSTRAINT "users_status_check_5dec1c59" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'DEACTIVATED'))
)
